en.content: The equivalents of ethylene diamine required to replace the neutral ligands from the coordination sphere of the trans-complex of CoCl<sub>3</sub> . 4NH<sub>3</sub> is _________. (Round off to the Nearest Integer).
en.explanation:
NH3 is the neutral monodentate ligand. Ethylene diamine is a neutral didentate ligand.

So, two ethylene diamine are equivalent to four 'NH3' ligand.
